name: Parricide
overview: The Bible records instances of parricide, highlighting the grave sin of children killing their own parents, as seen in the actions of Adrammelech and Sharezer who murdered their father while he worshipped false gods. These passages emphasize the consequences of rebellion within the family and the tragic downfall that follows such acts, underscoring the seriousness with which God views the sanctity of the parent-child relationship. The narrative reveals not only the physical violence but also the spiritual decay involved when respect for God and family is abandoned.
